BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to local government parking taxes; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.80 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Subject to the conditions of this section and in lieu of thetax authorized by RCW 82.80.030, the legislative authority of a county,city, or district may fix and impose a parking tax on allnonresidential parking within its respective jurisdiction. A city orcounty may impose the tax only to the extent that it has not beenimposed by the district in which such city or county is located, and adistrict may impose the tax only to the extent that it has not beenimposed by a city or county within the district. The jurisdiction ofa county, for purposes of this section, includes only theunincorporated area of the county. The jurisdiction of a city ordistrict includes only the area within the city or district'srespective boundaries. (2) The tax imposed in this section may be based upon the number of p. 1 SB 5910vehicles parking, the number of vehicle stalls available for parking,or the number of square feet available for parking. (3) The county, city, or district levying the tax provided for insubsection (1) of this section may provide for its payment on amonthly, quarterly, or annual basis. Each local government may developby ordinance or resolution rules for administering the tax, includingprovisions for reporting by businesses, collection, and enforcement. (4) The city, county, or district may provide that: (a) The tax applies to all parking, whether paid or not, includingparking supplied with a lease of nonresidential space; (b) The tax rate and the imposition of the tax varies with zoningor location of the business, the type of the business, the duration ofthe parking, the time of entry or exit, the type or use of the vehicle,or other reasonable factors; and (c) Disabled parking stalls, loading docks, or businesses withfewer than a certain number of stalls or less than a certain number ofsquare feet of parking are exempt from the tax. (5) A city, county, or district may not impose this tax on anybusiness that provides fewer than ten parking stalls. (6) The proceeds of the parking tax imposed by a city or countyunder subsection (1) of this section must be used for transportationpurposes in accordance with RCW 82.80.070 or for transportationimprovements in accordance with chapter 36.73 RCW. The proceeds of theparking tax imposed by a district must be used as provided in chapter36.120 RCW. (7)(a) The tax imposed in this section does not apply to a publicinstitution of higher education or a public or nonprofit hospital, ifsuch institution or hospital has: (i) An active commute trip reduction program as identified in RCW70.94.531; and (ii) Invested no less than one hundred ten percent of theinstitution or hospital's net parking proceeds into the commute tripreduction program during the previous reporting period. (b) For the purposes of this subsection, "public or nonprofithospital" only includes a public or nonprofit hospital that contractswith a public institution of higher education to provide hospital SB 5910 p. 2 services for the rendering of medical services or for teaching andresearch activities.
